name: Oceanblue Morningglory
desc: Oceanblue Morningglory (Ipomoea indica): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 6 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Ipomoea indica is a species of flowering plant in the family Convolvulaceae, known by several common names, including blue morning glory, oceanblue morning glory, koali awa, and blue dawn flower.
